entries.09e7733ce0d4ad0c: This business leases out logistics facilities; the securities report lists it as one of the services of the logistics business in its description of reportable segments. The securities report’s table of operating capacity notes warehouse rental area as “mainly logistics rental area,” and the warehouse rental area as of March 31, 2026 was 86,052 m² (down 19,526 m² from the previous fiscal year). The amount for logistics facility leasing is not separately disclosed in the securities report, and it is a separate category from the real estate business, which centers on office building leasing.

entries.23ad21aee83c9d3d: This business centers on the warehouse business, providing warehousing and handling, domestic land transport, international cargo handling and logistics facility leasing services. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥74,167 million (up 6.9% year on year), accounting for most of the consolidated operating revenue of ¥80,028 million. Operating revenue including internal operating revenue between segments was ¥74,186 million, and segment profit was ¥5,342 million (up 16.9% year on year). The securities report explains that storage fees, warehouse handling fees, land transport fees and international cargo handling fees increased due to higher utilization of logistics facilities newly opened in the previous fiscal year, the start of new transactions and expanded transactions with existing customers. As of March 31, 2026, the group’s storage area was 547,549 m², calculated as the total of 633,601 m² (owned area of 438,875 m² and leased warehouse area of 194,725 m²) less 86,052 m² of warehouse rental area, which is mainly logistics rental area. Separately, the securities report states that the overseas storage area was 28,983 m². The main subsidiaries carrying out the business are Yasuda Works (ownership of voting rights 62.5%), which handles warehouse handling; Hokkai Yasuda Soko, which operates a warehouse business in Hokkaido; Yasuda Unyu, which is engaged in land transport; Fuyo Air Cargo, which is engaged in international cargo handling; Nihon Business Logistics, which provides logistics management services; Yasuda Medical Logistics, which handles warehouse handling and storage management; and Yasuda Logi Pharma, which is engaged in pharmaceutical logistics. Overseas, the group has subsidiaries in China (Shanghai), Vietnam, Indonesia, Singapore and India. In the “Status of Affiliated Companies” section of the securities report, consolidated subsidiaries other than one real estate business company are classified under this business.
entries.500752be4c4b99b6: This business provides real estate leasing and other services, centered on office building leasing in the Tokyo and Yokohama areas.
entries.63e3d3a09d0e7f8d: This business transports cargo domestically by truck and similar vehicles, and corresponds to the “automobile transport business” in the handling volume table of the securities report. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, handled volume was 2,345,799 tons (up 2.7% year on year). Land transport subsidiaries include Yasuda Unyu, Onishi Unyu, Nanshin Kamotsu Jidosha, YSO Logi and Orient Service. The securities report notes, as a business environment factor, that domestic cargo transport was sluggish due to weak construction-related cargo. The amount for this category is not separately disclosed in the securities report, so only quantities are shown.

entries.7ad83afaffeea44a: This is a warehouse business that stores cargo and carries out handling work such as receiving and shipping. In the handling volume table of the securities report, the business is divided into “Warehouse Business (Storage)” and “Warehouse Business (Handling)”; in the fiscal year ended March 2026, the storage balance (quantity, monthly average) was 335,301 tons (up 8.8% year on year), inbound tonnage was 923,751 tons (up 18.6%) and outbound tonnage was 893,310 tons (up 17.0%). Subsidiaries involved in warehousing include Hokkai Yasuda Soko in Hokkaido, Yasuda Works for handling and Yasuda Logi Pharma for pharmaceutical logistics. The amount for this category is not separately disclosed in the securities report, so only quantities are shown.

entries.dccd55ae2c5e1247: This business provides real estate leasing and other services, centered on office building leasing in the Tokyo and Yokohama areas. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating revenue from external customers was ¥5,860 million (up 2.0% year on year); operating revenue including internal operating revenue between segments was ¥6,480 million, and segment profit was ¥2,026 million (up 10.0% year on year). The securities report explains that a mixed-use building completed at the west exit of Yokohama Station in the previous fiscal year operated smoothly, and that real estate rental income remained firm. As of March 31, 2026, the building rental area was 106,379 m², combining owned area of 102,028 m² and leased area of 4,351 m²; the areas are in Hokkaido, Tokyo and Kanagawa. The subsidiary Yasuda Estate Service provides management services for warehouse facilities and rental buildings, and the securities report states that the company entrusts it with managing buildings the company owns. The business description also lists the non-consolidated subsidiary Gotō Kenchiku Jimusho (facility management business) under this category.

entries.ff6523d9c8252a8b: This business arranges cargo transport to and from overseas, among other services. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, handled volume was 1,007,864 tons (up 10.3% year on year). In Japan, the business is handled by Fuyo Air Cargo, an international cargo handling company; overseas, subsidiaries in Shanghai, Vietnam, Indonesia, Singapore and India run international cargo handling businesses locally. The amount for this category is not separately disclosed in the securities report, so only quantities are shown.
